description: Tests whether a_D^(n)=lw(n-1) satisfies a CONSTANT-coefficient depth-2 recurrence (R=x^2-tau x+1). tau solved from the n<=4 seed = 2.6424 (= closed form), but the n=5 check lw(4)=tau*lw(3)-lw(2) FAILS (residual 0.0205, 0.4% of lw(4)); n=6 fails by 14%; n=7 worse. The windowed kernel drifts (tau_{n2,3,4}=2.6424 vs tau_{n3,4,5}=2.6505). A const-coeff depth-2 recurrence has a window-independent kernel, so lw(c) does NOT satisfy one => lw(n-1) != phi(M^n v0) for any fixed 2x2 M (Cayley-Hamilton). The a_D=lw prolonged-period identification is seed-deep only. lw(2)=(q+1)^2/(3q) and lw(3)=Family-A match the corpus exactly (convention validated).
discipline: no fit; sympy symbolic in q + mpmath 50dps at q0; (b)-exclusion of the const-coeff depth-2 model, invariant = window-independence of a const-coeff linear-recurrence kernel; scoped: refutes a_D=lw-as-prolonged-periods BEYOND the seed + the n=5 verification claim, NOT the Jac(Bring)~E^4 isogeny or the existence of a 2x2 M.
